// export BaseChainInfo = BaseChainInfo
export type BaseChainInfo<T extends ChainType> = {
    name: string;
    key: ChainKey;
    chainId: string | number;
    type: T;
    mainnet: boolean;
    logo: string;
    explorer: {
        baseUrl: string;
        txUrl: string;
        addressUrl: string;
        contractUrl: string;
    };
};
// export BaseSpokeChainConfig = BaseSpokeChainConfig
export type BaseSpokeChainConfig<T extends ChainType> = {
    chain: BaseChainInfo<T>;
    addresses: {
        [key: string]: string;
    };
    supportedTokens: Record<string, XToken>;
    nativeToken: string;
    bnUSD: string;
    pollingConfig: TxPollingConfig;
};

// export BitcoinRawTransactionReceipt = BitcoinRawTransactionReceipt
export interface BitcoinRawTransactionReceipt {
    txid: string;
    version: number;
    locktime: number;
    vin: BitcoinTransactionInput[];
    vout: BitcoinTransactionOutput[];
    size: number;
    weight: number;
    fee?: number;
    status: BitcoinTransactionStatus;
}

export type BitcoinReturnType<Raw extends boolean> = Raw extends true ? BitcoinRawTransaction | string : Raw extends false ? string : BitcoinRawTransaction | string;

    rpcUrl?: string;
};

};

        apiUrl: string;
        authUrl?: string;
        transactionsUrl?: string;

    };
};

// export BitcoinTransactionInput = BitcoinTransactionInput

    txid: string;

        value: number;
    };

    scriptsig_asm: string;
    witness?: string[];

    sequence: number;
    inner_redeemscript_asm?: string;
}

}

// export ClarityType = ClarityType
export declare enum ClarityType {
    Int = "int",
    UInt = "uint",
    Buffer = "buffer",
    BoolTrue = "true",
    BoolFalse = "false",
    PrincipalStandard = "address",
    PrincipalContract = "contract",
    ResponseOk = "ok",
    ResponseErr = "err",
    OptionalNone = "none",
    OptionalSome = "some",
    List = "list",
    Tuple = "tuple",
    StringASCII = "ascii",
    StringUTF8 = "utf8"
}

// export EVM_CHAIN_ID_TO_KEY = EVM_CHAIN_ID_TO_KEY
export declare const EVM_CHAIN_ID_TO_KEY: ReadonlyMap<number, EvmChainKey>;
// export EVM_CHAIN_KEYS = EVM_CHAIN_KEYS
export declare const EVM_CHAIN_KEYS: ChainKeysByType<"EVM">[];
// export EVM_CHAIN_KEYS_SET = EVM_CHAIN_KEYS_SET
export declare const EVM_CHAIN_KEYS_SET: Set<ChainKeysByType<"EVM">>;
// export EVM_SPOKE_ONLY_CHAIN_KEYS = EVM_SPOKE_ONLY_CHAIN_KEYS
export declare const EVM_SPOKE_ONLY_CHAIN_KEYS: ("0xa86a.avax" | "0xa4b1.arbitrum" | "0x2105.base" | "0x38.bsc" | "0xa.optimism" | "0x89.polygon" | "hyper" | "lightlink" | "ethereum" | "redbelly" | "0x2019.kaia" | "hedera" | "robinhood")[];
// export EVM_SPOKE_ONLY_CHAIN_KEYS_SET = EVM_SPOKE_ONLY_CHAIN_KEYS_SET
export declare const EVM_SPOKE_ONLY_CHAIN_KEYS_SET: Set<"0xa86a.avax" | "0xa4b1.arbitrum" | "0x2105.base" | "0x38.bsc" | "0xa.optimism" | "0x89.polygon" | "hyper" | "lightlink" | "ethereum" | "redbelly" | "0x2019.kaia" | "hedera" | "robinhood">;
// export EvmAtomicBatchSupport = EvmAtomicBatchSupport
export type EvmAtomicBatchSupport = 'supported' | 'ready' | 'unsupported';
// export EvmBatchReceipt = EvmBatchReceipt
export type EvmBatchReceipt = {
    transactionHash: Hash;
    status: 'success' | 'reverted';
};
// export EvmBatchResult = EvmBatchResult
export type EvmBatchResult = {
    status: 'success' | 'failure';
    statusCode: number;
    atomic: boolean;
    receipts: readonly EvmBatchReceipt[];
};
// export EvmChainKey = EvmChainKey
export type EvmChainKey = ChainKeysByType<'EVM'>;
// export EvmContractCall = EvmContractCall
export type EvmContractCall = {
    address: Address;
    value: bigint;
    data: Hex;
};
// export EvmGasEstimate = EvmGasEstimate
export type EvmGasEstimate = bigint;
// export EvmRawLog = EvmRawLog
export type EvmRawLog = {
    address: Address;
    topics: [
        Hex,
        ...Hex[]
    ] | [
    ];
    data: Hex;
    blockHash: Hash | null;
    blockNumber: Address | null;
    logIndex: Hex | null;
    transactionHash: Hash | null;
    transactionIndex: Hex | null;
    removed: boolean;
};
// export EvmRawTransaction = EvmRawTransaction
export type EvmRawTransaction = {
    from: Address;
    to: Address;
    value: bigint;
    data: Hex;
};
// export EvmRawTransactionReceipt = EvmRawTransactionReceipt
export type EvmRawTransactionReceipt = {
    transactionHash: string;
    transactionIndex: string;
    blockHash: string;
    blockNumber: string;
    from: string;
    to: string | null;
    cumulativeGasUsed: string;
    gasUsed: string;
    contractAddress: string | null;
    logs: EvmRawLog[];
    logsBloom: string;
    status?: string;
    type?: string;
    effectiveGasPrice?: string;
};
// export EvmReturnType = EvmReturnType
export type EvmReturnType<Raw extends boolean> = Raw extends true ? EvmRawTransaction : Raw extends false ? Hex : Hex | EvmRawTransaction;
// export EvmSendBatchOptions = EvmSendBatchOptions
export type EvmSendBatchOptions = {
    expectedChainId: number;
};
// export EvmSendTransactionOptions = EvmSendTransactionOptions
export type EvmSendTransactionOptions = {
    expectedChainId?: number;
};
// export EvmSharedChainConfig = EvmSharedChainConfig
export type EvmSharedChainConfig = TxPollingConfig & {
    rpcUrl: string;
};
// export EvmSpokeChainConfig = EvmSpokeChainConfig
export type EvmSpokeChainConfig = BaseSpokeChainConfig<'EVM'> & {
    addresses: {
        assetManager: Address;
        connection: Address;
    };
    nativeToken: string;
    rpcUrl: string;
};
// export EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey = EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey
export type EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey = Exclude<EvmChainKey, HubChainKey> & keyof typeof spokeChainConfig;
// export EvmWaitForBatchOptions = EvmWaitForBatchOptions
export type EvmWaitForBatchOptions = {
    timeout?: number;
};
// export ExecuteAction = ExecuteAction
export type ExecuteAction<A> = Extract<A, {
    raw?: false;
}>;
// export FalseCV = FalseCV
export interface FalseCV {
    type: ClarityType.BoolFalse;
}
// export FEE_PERCENTAGE_SCALE = FEE_PERCENTAGE_SCALE
export declare const FEE_PERCENTAGE_SCALE = 10000n;
// export FeeAmount = FeeAmount
export type FeeAmount = {
    feeAmount: bigint;
};

// export Optional = Optional

    src_chain_id: number;

// export ResponseCV = ResponseCV
export type ResponseCV = ResponseErrorCV | ResponseOkCV;
// export ResponseErrorCV = ResponseErrorCV
export interface ResponseErrorCV<T extends ClarityValue = ClarityValue> {
    readonly type: ClarityType.ResponseErr;
    readonly value: T;
}
// export ResponseOkCV = ResponseOkCV
export interface ResponseOkCV<T extends ClarityValue = ClarityValue> {
    readonly type: ClarityType.ResponseOk;
    readonly value: T;
}
// export Result = Result
export type Result<T, E = Error | unknown> = {
    ok: true;
    value: T;
} | {
    ok: false;
    error: E;
};

// export RpcConfig = RpcConfig
export type RpcConfig = Partial<{
    [K in ChainKey]: K extends typeof ChainKeys.STELLAR_MAINNET ? StellarRpcConfig : K extends typeof ChainKeys.BITCOIN_MAINNET ? BitcoinRpcConfig : K extends typeof ChainKeys.INJECTIVE_MAINNET ? InjectiveRpcConfig : K extends typeof ChainKeys.STACKS_MAINNET ? StacksNetworkName | StacksNetworkLike : string;
}>;
// export RpcFailoverConfig = RpcFailoverConfig
export type RpcFailoverConfig = {
    rpcUrls?: readonly string[];
    rpcOptions?: RpcFallbackOptions;
};
// export RpcFallbackOptions = RpcFallbackOptions
export type RpcFallbackOptions = {
    rank?: boolean;
    retryCount?: number;
    retryDelay?: number;
};
// export SDK_VERSION = SDK_VERSION
export declare const SDK_VERSION: string;
// export SendMsgArgs = SendMsgArgs
export interface SendMsgArgs {
    dst_chain_id: number;
    dst_address: Array<number>;
    payload: Array<number>;
}
// export SetHubConfig = SetHubConfig
export interface SetHubConfig {
    hub_chain_id: number;
    hub_asset_manager: number[];
}
// export ShareBalanceResponseV2 = ShareBalanceResponseV2
export interface ShareBalanceResponseV2 {
    balance: string;
}
// export SignDoc = SignDoc
export interface SignDoc {
    bodyBytes: Uint8Array;
    authInfoBytes: Uint8Array;
    chainId: string;
    accountNumber: bigint;
}
// export Slot0 = Slot0
export type Slot0<TPoolType extends PoolType | unknown = unknown> = TPoolType extends 'CL' ? CLSlot0 : TPoolType extends 'Bin' ? BinSlot0 : unknown;
// export SodaTokens = SodaTokens
export declare const SodaTokens: {
    readonly sodaBNB: {
        readonly symbol: "BNB";
        readonly name: "BNB";
        readonly decimals: 18;

// export SodaxConfig = SodaxConfig
export type SodaxConfig = Prettify<SodaxDefaultConfig & SodaxOptionalConfig>;
// export SodaxConfigV2 = SodaxConfigV2
export type SodaxConfigV2 = Omit<SodaxDefaultConfig, 'dex' | 'relay'> & {
    dex: DexConfigV2;
    relay: RelayConfigV2;
};
// export SodaxDefaultConfig = SodaxDefaultConfig
export type SodaxDefaultConfig = {
    chains: Record<SpokeChainKey, SpokeChainConfig>;
    swaps: SwapsDefaultConfig;
    moneyMarket: MoneyMarketDefaultConfig;
    bridge: BridgeDefaultConfig;
    dex: DexDefaultConfig;
    leverageYield: LeverageYieldDefaultConfig;
    hub: HubConfig;
    api: ApiConfig;
    solver: SolverConfig;
    relay: RelayConfig;
};
// export SodaxFeature = SodaxFeature
export type SodaxFeature = 'swap' | 'moneyMarket' | 'bridge' | 'staking' | 'migration' | 'dex' | 'partner' | 'recovery' | 'backend' | 'sponsoring' | 'leverageYield';
// export SodaxLogger = SodaxLogger
export interface SodaxLogger {
    debug(message: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    info(message: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    warn(message: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    error(message: string, error?: unknown, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
}
// export SodaxLoggerOption = SodaxLoggerOption
export type SodaxLoggerOption = SodaxLogger | 'console' | 'silent';
// export SodaxOptionalConfig = SodaxOptionalConfig
export type SodaxOptionalConfig = {
    logger?: SodaxLoggerOption;
    analytics?: AnalyticsOption;
    fee?: PartnerFee;
    apiKey?: string;
    radfi?: RadfiOptions;
    swaps?: SwapsOptions;
    moneyMarket?: MoneyMarketOptions;
    bridge?: BridgeOptions;
    leverageYield?: LeverageYieldOptions;
    swapsOptions?: SwapsClientOptions;
    bridgeOptions?: BridgeClientOptions;
};
// export SodaxOptions = SodaxOptions
export type SodaxOptions = DeepPartial<SodaxDefaultConfig> & SodaxOptionalConfig;
// export SOLANA_CHAIN_KEYS = SOLANA_CHAIN_KEYS
export declare const SOLANA_CHAIN_KEYS: "solana"[];
// export SOLANA_CHAIN_KEYS_SET = SOLANA_CHAIN_KEYS_SET
export declare const SOLANA_CHAIN_KEYS_SET: Set<"solana">;
// export SolanaAccountMeta = SolanaAccountMeta
export type SolanaAccountMeta = {
    pubkey: SolanaBase58PublicKey;
    isSigner: boolean;
    isWritable: boolean;
};
// export SolanaBase58PublicKey = SolanaBase58PublicKey
export type SolanaBase58PublicKey = string;
// export SolanaChainConfig = SolanaChainConfig
export type SolanaChainConfig = BaseSpokeChainConfig<'SOLANA'> & {
    addresses: {
        assetManager: string;
        connection: string;
        xTokenManager: string;
        rateLimit: string;
    };
    rpcUrl: string;
    walletAddress: string;
    nativeToken: string;
    gasPrice: string;
};
// export SolanaChainKey = SolanaChainKey
export type SolanaChainKey = ChainKeysByType<'SOLANA'>;
// export SolanaEoaAddress = SolanaEoaAddress
export type SolanaEoaAddress = string;
// export SolanaGasEstimate = SolanaGasEstimate
export type SolanaGasEstimate = number | undefined;
// export SolanaRawTransaction = SolanaRawTransaction
export type SolanaRawTransaction = {
    from: SolanaBase58PublicKey;
    to: SolanaBase58PublicKey;
    value: bigint;
    data: Base64String;
};
// export SolanaRawTransactionInstruction = SolanaRawTransactionInstruction
export type SolanaRawTransactionInstruction = {
    keys: Array<SolanaAccountMeta>;
    programId: SolanaBase58PublicKey;
    data: Uint8Array;
};
// export SolanaRawTransactionReceipt = SolanaRawTransactionReceipt
export type SolanaRawTransactionReceipt = VersionedTransactionResponse;
// export SolanaReturnType = SolanaReturnType
export type SolanaReturnType<Raw extends boolean> = Raw extends true ? SolanaRawTransaction : Raw extends false ? string : SolanaRawTransaction | string;
// export SolanaRpcResponseAndContext = SolanaRpcResponseAndContext
export type SolanaRpcResponseAndContext<T> = {
    context: Context;
    value: T;
};
// export SolanaSerializedTransaction = SolanaSerializedTransaction
export type SolanaSerializedTransaction = Uint8Array;
// export SolanaSignatureResult = SolanaSignatureResult
export type SolanaSignatureResult = {
    err: TransactionError | null;
};

// export SolverIntentErrorCode = SolverIntentErrorCode

    NO_PATH_FOUND = -4,

    NOT_ENOUGH_PRIVATE_LIQUIDITY = -8,
    NO_EXECUTION_MODULE_FOUND = -7,
    QUOTE_NOT_FOUND = -8,
    QUOTE_NOT_MATCH = -9,
    INTENT_DATA_NOT_MATCH_QUOTE = -10,
    NO_GAS_HANDLER_FOR_BLOCKCHAIN = -11,
    INTENT_NOT_FOUND = -12,
    QUOTE_EXPIRED = -13,
    MAX_INPUT_AMOUNT = -14,
    MAX_DIFF_OUTPUT = -15,
    STOPPED = -16,
    NO_ORACLE_MODULE_FOUND = -17,
    NEGATIVE_INPUT_AMOUNT = -18,
    INTENT_ALREADY_IN_ORDERBOOK = -19,
    CREATE_INTENT_ORDER_FAILED = -998,
    UNKNOWN = -999
}

    STARTED_NOT_FINISHED = 2,
    SOLVED = 3,
    FAILED = 4
}

    readonly type: ClarityType.OptionalSome;
    readonly value: T;
}

// export StellarAssetTrustline = StellarAssetTrustline
export type StellarAssetTrustline = {
    assetCode: string;
    contractId: string;
    assetIssuer: string;
};
// export StellarChainKey = StellarChainKey
export type StellarChainKey = ChainKeysByType<'STELLAR'>;
// export StellarGasEstimate = StellarGasEstimate
export type StellarGasEstimate = bigint;
// export StellarRawTransaction = StellarRawTransaction
export type StellarRawTransaction = {
    from: string;
    to: string;
    value: bigint;
    data: string;
};
// export StellarRawTransactionReceipt = StellarRawTransactionReceipt
export type StellarRawTransactionReceipt = {
    _links: {
        self: {
            href: string;
        };
        account: {
            href: string;
        };
        ledger: {
            href: string;
        };
        operations: {
            href: string;
        };
        effects: {
            href: string;
        };
        precedes: {
            href: string;
        };
        succeeds: {
            href: string;
        };
        transaction: {
            href: string;
        };
    };
    id: string;
    paging_token: string;
    successful: boolean;
    hash: string;
    ledger_attr: number;
    created_at: string;
    source_account: string;
    source_account_sequence: string;
    fee_account: string;
    fee_bump_transaction?: {
        hash: string;
        signatures: string[];
    };
    inner_transaction?: {
        hash: string;
        signatures: string[];
    };
    envelope_xdr: XDR;
    result_xdr: XDR;
    result_meta_xdr: XDR;
    fee_meta_xdr: XDR;
    memo?: string;
    memo_type?: string;
    signatures: XDR[];
    valid_after?: string;
    valid_before?: string;
    fee_charged: number | string;
    max_fee: number | string;
    operation_count: number;
};
// export StellarReturnType = StellarReturnType
export type StellarReturnType<Raw extends boolean> = Raw extends true ? StellarRawTransaction : Raw extends false ? string : StellarRawTransaction | string;

    sorobanRpcUrl?: string;
};

};
// export StellarSorobanFailedTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanFailedTransactionReceipt
export type StellarSorobanFailedTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanBaseResponse & {
    status: 'FAILED';
    ledger: number;
    createdAt: number;
    applicationOrder: number;
    feeBump: boolean;
};
// export StellarSorobanMissingTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanMissingTransactionReceipt
export type StellarSorobanMissingTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanBaseResponse & {
    status: 'NOT_FOUND';
};
// export StellarSorobanSuccessfulTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanSuccessfulTransactionReceipt
export type StellarSorobanSuccessfulTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanBaseResponse & {
    status: 'SUCCESS';
    ledger: number;
    createdAt: number;
    applicationOrder: number;
    feeBump: boolean;
};
// export StellarSorobanTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanTransactionReceipt
export type StellarSorobanTransactionReceipt = StellarSorobanSuccessfulTransactionReceipt | StellarSorobanFailedTransactionReceipt | StellarSorobanMissingTransactionReceipt;

    baseFee: string;
};

// export StorageDepositArgs = StorageDepositArgs
export interface StorageDepositArgs {
    account_id: string;
    registration_only?: boolean;
}
// export StringAsciiCV = StringAsciiCV
export interface StringAsciiCV {
    readonly type: ClarityType.StringASCII;
    readonly value: string;
}
// export StringUtf8CV = StringUtf8CV

};

// export TxReturnType = TxReturnType
export type TxReturnType<C extends SpokeChainKey | ChainType, Raw extends boolean> = GetChainType<C> extends 'EVM' ? EvmReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'SOLANA' ? SolanaReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'STELLAR' ? StellarReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'ICON' ? IconReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'SUI' ? SuiReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'INJECTIVE' ? InjectiveReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'STACKS' ? StacksReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'NEAR' ? NearReturnType<Raw> : GetChainType<C> extends 'BITCOIN' ? BitcoinReturnType<Raw> : GetDefaultTxReturnType<Raw>;
